# OBS Video Timer Dock (obs-media-info)

> A free OBS Studio custom browser dock that automatically detects which video (media source) is playing in the active scene and shows elapsed time, remaining time and a progress bar live. Selected sources can be paused and resumed. Uses obs-websocket v5 (built into OBS 28+). Single HTML file, no installation, no dependencies.

Live URL (paste into OBS: Docks > Custom Browser Docks): https://vidiverse.github.io/obs-media-info/

## Docs
- [README](https://github.com/VIDIVERSE/obs-media-info/blob/main/README.md): English and German setup guide, features, limitations, version history
- [CLAUDE.md](https://github.com/VIDIVERSE/obs-media-info/blob/main/CLAUDE.md): project conventions and technical notes

## Key facts
- Keywords: OBS Studio, media source timer, video countdown, remaining time, browser dock, obs-websocket, livestream, streaming overlay tool
- Supports media sources of type ffmpeg_source and vlc_source in the active program scene
- License: MIT
- Made by the Junglecraft Social-Media-Team for JungleCraft livestreams
